description: Golden dataset v1 for semantic + lexical search evaluation with 42 queries

relevance_guidelines.3: Highly relevant - strong match addressing core query intent with direct applicability
relevance_guidelines.2: Moderately relevant - valid match that partially addresses query intent or provides complementary value
relevance_guidelines.1: Weakly relevant - tangential connection or limited applicability to the query intent

coverage_approach: Comprehensive evaluation with 1-3 relevance scoring. Each query includes exactly 10 expected results ranked by relevance. Scores: 3=highly relevant, 2=moderately relevant, 1=weakly relevant. Dataset designed to test precision, recall, ambiguity handling, and robustness across diverse query types and categories.
notes: Regenerated golden dataset with new 1-3 relevance scale. All 42 queries evaluated with top-10 results per query. Total of 420 judgments. Queries distributed across all four categories (tools, service_providers, courses, case_studies) with intentional coverage of edge cases, spelling errors, ambiguity, and multi-category scenarios.
